Our Story

We Exist to Help People Thrive.

Driven by a passion for human potential, we specialize in building mental toughness, well-being, and emotional intelligence — using only evidence-based methods that deliver real, lasting results.

We empower individuals to rise above challenges, break through barriers, and unlock possibilities they once thought out of reach. This isn't just another institute — we are a catalyst for transformation.

Our mission is simple yet profound: to build mental fortitude and emotional agility in every person we touch. Backed by science, fueled by purpose, inspired by potential.

Become Unshakable! Become the Best Version of Yourself!

Why Choose Us

Why Us?

01

We Don't Promise, We Deliver

We don't promise a magic pill, quick fixes, or instant transformations — because those don't exist. Instead, we offer a powerful journey to self-discovery, helping you harness your strengths and understand your weaknesses to become the architect of your own success. Upgrade your mindset, conquer your fears, and seize control of your life.

02

Evidence Based Strategies

Discover effective strategies and techniques that empower you to overcome challenges, build resilience, and thrive in all aspects of your life. All our work is grounded in positive psychology and neuroscience — and we bring the latest research to life in our practice.

03

Resources

We have combined our experiences and spent years researching the best psychological strategies to create the most powerful resources. Access our collection of ebooks, workbooks, and journals covering a wide range of topics related to personal growth, mental toughness, and psychological well-being.

The Person Behind the Mission

Our Founder

CEO & Founder

Gilda Wake
CEO & Founder, Mental Toughness Institute

Gilda loves nothing more than unlocking human potential. She designs and delivers powerful programs that boost wellbeing, sharpen decision-making, strengthen relationships, and elevate performance.

With a deep passion for the science of resilience and a gift for making psychology practical and accessible, Gilda has helped thousands of individuals and organisations worldwide build the mental fortitude to thrive — not just survive.

Her work is grounded in evidence, driven by purpose, and guided by an unshakable belief that every person has the capacity to become their best self.

Our Services

1-on-1 · Personal Coaching

Personal Mental Toughness Coaching

Unlock your inner resilience and thrive under pressure with our specialized Personal Coaching in Mental Toughness. Designed to help you conquer challenges and excel in all areas of life, our one-on-one sessions focus on developing the mental fortitude needed to succeed.

Empower yourself with the mental toughness to overcome any obstacle.

Group · Community

Group Mental Toughness Coaching

Our group coaching service offers a supportive and collaborative environment for individuals to develop mental toughness. Through group activities and discussions, we help individuals cultivate resilience, improve their emotional intelligence, and develop effective coping strategies.

Strengthen your resilience with the power of a supportive community.

Sign Up Today
1-on-1 · Parenting

Stoic Parenting Coaching

Parenting will always test your patience — but it doesn't have to drain your peace. Stoic Parenting Coaching is a 1:1 journey designed to help you stay calm, grounded, and confident through practical Stoic principles and modern psychology.

Transform daily chaos into moments of clarity — lead your family with strength, empathy, and presence.

On Stage & In Conversation

Speaking Engagements

Gilda Wake delivers powerful, evidence-based keynotes and workshops on mental toughness, emotional intelligence, and human potential — for organisations, conferences, and events worldwide.

Why Book Gilda

A Speaker Who Moves People.

Gilda doesn't just deliver information — she creates experiences that shift perspectives, ignite action, and leave audiences with tools they can use immediately.

Drawing on cutting-edge psychology, neuroscience, and years of coaching experience, her talks combine intellectual rigour with raw authenticity — the kind that makes people lean forward in their seats.

Whether addressing a boardroom of executives, a stadium of athletes, or a community of parents, Gilda meets every audience where they are — and takes them somewhere new.

Featured Talk

TEDx Cluj 2023

Gilda took the TEDx stage in Cluj, Romania in 2023 — delivering a talk that challenged the audience to rethink their relationship with discomfort, adversity, and their own potential.

The talk drew on her deep expertise in mental toughness and positive psychology to make a compelling, evidence-based case for leaning into difficulty rather than away from it.

Keynotes & Workshops

Talk Topics

01

The Art of Mental Toughness

What separates those who thrive under pressure from those who crumble? An evidence-based deep dive into the six pillars of mental toughness and how to develop them.

02

Your Comfort Zone Is Keeping You Small

A provocative, science-backed talk on why discomfort is the price of growth — and how to stop letting your brain's survival instincts run your life.

03

Emotional Mastery Under Pressure

How to feel everything and be governed by nothing. Practical tools from positive psychology and neuroscience for managing emotions when the stakes are high.

04

Happiness & Flourishing

What does it really mean to flourish? Grounded in positive psychology and the science of wellbeing, this talk redefines success and shows audiences how to build a life that truly thrives.

05

Resilience in the Workplace

Tailored for corporate audiences — a compelling case for why mental toughness is the most valuable asset any organisation can cultivate in its people, and a roadmap for doing so.

06

Bespoke & Custom Talks

Every audience is different. Gilda works closely with event organisers to craft bespoke talks tailored to your theme, industry, and the specific outcomes you want your audience to leave with.
